title: Westside For Skinny Bastards V3
author: W
desc:
This program is designed to build strength, size, and athleticism, tailored for individuals who want to balance performance and aesthetics. Incorporating a four-day split with two Max Effort days (Upper and Lower), one Repetition day for hypertrophy, and one Dynamic Effort day to enhance explosive power. Ideal for athletes, hard gainers, or anyone looking to break plateaus, the program emphasizes progressive overload, accessory work, and sport-specific conditioning to ensure consistent progress and versatility. I highly recommend reading the full article online before starting to get a good understanding of the program.

Reccomended Structure:
Monday: ME Upper Body
Tuesday: Dynamic Lower Body
Thursday: Repetition Upper Body
Friday: ME Lower Body 

Warm-Ups:
Joe has his own “Limber 11” and “Simple 6” mobility routines, which are excellent for warm ups & off day mobility. You can find these tutorials on YouTube.

Modifications:
I did not change the ME lifts throughout the 12 weeks - this is up to you. Once you cannot progress anymore on your 3-5 rep max set, switch exercises. Joe recommends every 3rd week. Try to switch your assistance work atleast once during the 12 week cycle too. 

I have kept the program the exact same, with only addition of AMRAP tricep finishers on both upper days - as I know the bro’s would like more tricep work. Feel free to adjust this to your needs though, but don’t overdo it. 

Conditioning:
Check out the original post by Joe regarding conditioning. If you plan on doing high intensity training (sprints, speed training, long endurance runs) feel free to remove the dynamic effort lower day. 

If running the full 4 days, program conditioning appropriately. Whether you would like to do this after your workout, on an off day etc is up to you. Joe recommends sled & prowler work, but feel free to do anything that will help with general fitness and conditioning, just make sure you get it done!

For those who aren’t worried about conditioning or a 2nd leg day, Joe recommends removing the Dynamic Leg day, and replacing it with a “Vanity Day” to target biceps, triceps, shoulders etc. This is entirely your choice.

ex.note:
Work up to a max set of 3-5 reps in one of the following exercises: Barbell Bench Press, Barbell Incline Press, Weighted Chins, Close Grip Barbell Bench Press, Rack Lockouts. 

Rotate every 4th week.
2 sets of max reps (15-20 reps on the 1st set: rest 3-4 minutes between sets). Alternative exercises: Flat DB bench press, Triceps Death, Chin Ups (only if ME exercise wasn't chin ups), Floor Press

ss.note: Perform 3-4 supersets of 8-12 reps of each exercise. Alternatives: Barbell rows, Seated cable rows (various bars), T-bar rows, Chest supported rows
Perform 3-4 supersets of 8-12 reps of each exercise. Alternatives: Rear delt flyes, Scarecrows, Seated DB “power cleans”, Band pull-aparts

Superset one exercise from “Group 1” with one exercise from “Group 2.” Perform 3-4 supersets of 8-12 reps of each exercise.
Group 1
Lat pulldowns (various bars)
Chin-ups

Group 2
Rear delt flyes
Scarecrows
Face pulls
Seated DB “power cleans”
Band pull-aparts

ex.note:
Medial delts – choose one of the following exercises and perform 4 sets of 8-12 reps:
DB lateral raises
L-lateral raises
Cable lateral raises
DB military press
DB side press

ss.note:
Traps / Arms superset – SS one exercise from “Group 1” with one exercise from “Group 2.” Perform 3 supersets.
Group 1 (Perform 8-10 reps)
DB shrugs
Barbell shrugs
Trap bar shrugs
Behind Back BB Shrug

Group 2
Barbell curls (8-10)
DB curls (8-10)
Seated Incline DB curls (8-10)
Hammer curls (8-10)
Zottmann curls (8-10)
Iso-hold DB Curls (8-10)
Triceps extensions (10-15)
Triceps pushdown (15-25)

ex.note: Select any grip/forearm exercise that feels comfortable for you.
